meta.title: 为啥「更软」的树，反而更危险？刹车坏了，如何自救？
meta.title_en: Why Is the Softer Tree More Dangerous? How to Survive a Brake Failure
meta.topic: 汽车安全 · 物理 · 避险驾驶

scenes.title_cn: 直觉陷阱：软的树怎么反而危险
scenes.title_en: The Intuition Trap: How a Softer Tree Becomes More Dangerous
scenes.context: 撞上『更软』的树，对车和人反而更危险。看似违反直觉，但碰撞安全的本质不是『撞什么』，而是『能量怎么转化』。
sentences: 撞上看起来更软的树，反而更危险。
Hitting the tree that looks softer is actually more dangerous.
counterintuitive（反直觉的）
决定伤亡的不是速度，而是能量怎么转化。
What decides the outcome isn't speed — it's how the energy is converted.
energy conversion（能量转化）
人受不了的不是碰撞，是瞬间停下。
It's not the impact that kills you — it's stopping in an instant.
instant（瞬间）
paraphrase: The gentler-looking object can be the deadliest one.
「真正杀人的是急停」换种说法
Sudden deceleration is what breaks the body.
scenes.speak: Hitting the tree that looks softer is actually more dangerous. What decides the outcome isn't speed — it's how the energy is converted. It's not the impact that kills you — it's stopping in an instant.

scenes.title_cn: 能量两条路：吸能溃缩 vs 刚性反弹
scenes.title_en: Two Paths for Energy: Crush Absorption vs. Rigid Rebound
scenes.context: 硬质墙体把碰撞能量直接反弹回车身，乘员舱被挤扁；高而软的树像一根弹性巨大的『鞭子』，把冲击变成剧烈的甩动，乘员在车里被反复撕扯。
sentences: 硬墙把能量直接反弹回车身。
A rigid wall bounces the energy straight back into the car.
rigid（刚性的）
软树像一根巨大的鞭子。
A soft tree acts like a giant whip.
whip（鞭子）
车里的人不是被撞伤，是被甩伤。
You're not crushed by the impact — you're whipped around inside the car.
whipped around（被甩动）
paraphrase: The wall gives nothing, so the cabin takes everything.
The tree stores energy and cracks it back through the chassis.
scenes.speak: A rigid wall bounces the energy straight back into the car. A soft tree acts like a giant whip. You're not crushed by the impact — you're whipped around inside the car.

scenes.title_cn: 刹失灵的自救顺序：抢挡→手刹→蹭护栏
scenes.title_en: Brake Failure Playbook: Downshift, Handbrake, Guardrail
scenes.context: 刹车失灵时不要慌，按顺序操作：自动挡抢到 L 挡或手动模式逐级降挡，利用发动机牵制减速；接着轻点电子手刹，最后实在不行用车身侧面蹭护栏减速。
sentences: 第一步，逐级降挡，用发动机牵制减速。
First, downshift step by step and let the engine brake you.
engine braking（发动机制动）
第二步，轻点电子手刹，别一把拉死。
Second, tap the electronic handbrake — don't yank it.
tap（轻点）
实在不行，用车身侧面去蹭护栏。
As a last resort, rub the side of the car against the guardrail.
last resort（最后手段）
paraphrase: Let the gears fight the speed for you.
Turn concrete into your brake pad.
scenes.speak: First, downshift step by step and let the engine brake you. Second, tap the electronic handbrake — don't yank it. As a last resort, rub the side of the car against the guardrail.

scenes.title_cn: 止损哲学：用可控伤害换生命
scenes.title_en: The Philosophy of Loss Control: Trade Damage for Life
scenes.context: 避险的核心是『用可控的伤害，换不可挽回的生命』。宁可撞低速的树、蹭护栏毁掉车身，也不要让车失控冲向人群或悬崖。
sentences: 关键是用可控的伤害，换不可挽回的生命。
The key is trading controllable damage for irreplaceable lives.
irreplaceable（不可替代的）
损失车身，好过失去一切。
Losing the car is better than losing everything.
trade-off（权衡）
失控冲向人群，是最坏的选择。
Plowing into a crowd is the worst possible outcome.
plow into（冲撞）
paraphrase: Pick the smaller loss while you still can.
scenes.speak: The key is trading controllable damage for irreplaceable lives. Losing the car is better than losing everything. Plowing into a crowd is the worst possible outcome.

practice: 「逐级降挡用发动机制动」怎么表达？
Downshift gradually and use engine braking.
「两害相权取其轻」用英文怎么说？
Trade controllable damage for your life.
Don't yank the handbrake all at once.
pitfalls: Steer into the softest-looking object thinking it's safer.
Understand that energy path matters more than looks.
A whipping tree can hurt you more than a rigid wall.
Yank the handbrake hard the moment brakes fail.
Tap the electronic handbrake gently and repeatedly.
A hard yank at speed can spin the car out of control.
Panic and brake nothing while searching for a reason.
Run the sequence: downshift, handbrake, guardrail.
Muscle memory saves you only if you rehearse the order.
Steer toward the crowd to avoid damaging the car.
Choose the controlled crash that preserves life.
Property is replaceable; people are not.
shifts: 理解关键是能量路径与可控伤害
抢挡、点手刹、蹭护栏的顺序固定执行
用可控损伤换生命优先
